254.s: Clementin gives his birth year (1894), says he was a bricklayer and discusses how long they have lived in the house and where they lived before.
254.q: Well, first of all, when were you born in the Claremont? 1894. 2587. And what was your job? Did you have any trade? I was in bricklayer work. How long have you been living in this house? About 55 years. In this house, yes. More than that. No, no, we lived in another house.

827.t: Father's death in 1916 and Arthur's birth in 1903
827.s: Arthur gives his birth date, says his father died when he was 13 at about 52, after a hard-to-hear garbled year.
827.q: No. He died in around, let's see, I can probably tell you just when he died. About what year? John. John. When he died, I was 13 years old when he died.

773.t: Her age, husband's death in 1946 and his insurance job
773.s: She gives her birth year (1892) and says her husband died of a heart attack in 1946 at about 60; he was an insurance agent.
773.q: 31st of January. And only if he lived, let's see, he was 60 when he died. Died of a heart attack. Oh, I see. He was 61.

921.s: Hilda gives her father's age at death (52) and dates: died 23 November 1933, born 26 October.
921.q: My father was 52 years old and he died November 23rd, 1933. 33.

252.s: Carrie Boote says she was born in October 1873 in Mobile, Alabama, and grew up there.
252.q: In October 18 and 73 in Mobile, Alabama.

763.t: His real birth date and the christening mistake
763.s: Born June 10, 1889 by his papers, but christened at three, so he thinks he is older; this caused trouble with the union card.
763.q: That's the date that's on your Christmas date? Yeah. But what I was to come to understand by my parents, that there was a mistake on there, because, you see, as a rule, they didn't christen the children at that time as fast as they christened them. Now, well, you can say if they were, if they would…

42.t: Birth, address and arrival in America in 1955
42.s: Joe Lyde gives his name, birth in Worcester in 1934, parents in Belfast, and arriving in the US in October 1955.
42.q: I don't have one. I don't have one. I was 21 when I was just before I left to come here, and I'm not a registered voter anywhere, but I guess I can register and vote in the British election when I get back this year.

619.s: Laurent gives his full name, how Laurent is pronounced, and his birth on 28 August 1897, St. Augustine's day.
619.q: St. August, listen. I'm on 28th day of August. St. Augustine day. My mother's name Augustine and they named me August. All that on that scene. Yeah.

713.t: The uncle's last job at the Budweiser and his age
713.s: Russell and Nelson confirm that the Budweiser was the uncle's last job and that he was about twenty years older than Nelson.
713.ch: Second reel: instrument, style and wrap-up

665.t: Babe's hidden age and her social security trouble
665.s: Babe claimed to be 49 when they married; since his death she struggles to prove his true age, trying baptismal records.
665.q: he's, he's age 49, but I know different. He looked good at that time for his age, but I know different. What year did you get married? We married in, I can't remember. He was 31 or something like that.

778.t: Her lost birth certificate and the 1901 date
778.s: Her certificate burned in a courthouse fire and the census bureau assigned 1901, about three years too early.
778.q: Oh, oh. So that's what it is, see. But they didn't make it. But I had to go buy it because I didn't have nothing else to go buy it. I had to get my license, you see. So that's why I had to have it. So that's what's on your license? I don't know.

830.t: Dates of birth and death of George McCullum Sr. and his son
830.s: Mrs. McCullum gives her husband's birth (1884) and death (Nov. 14, 1920) and her son George Jr.'s birth (1906) and death (1938), clearing up husband versus son.
830.q: Oh, he was born on July 27th, 1884. 1884. Because we were just about 11 months at different times, and I was born the same age we were born. And he's from there, it's going to be 40 years now. About almost 40 years. Yeah, the 14th of next month. 14th of next month. Yeah, 1920.

690.t: Excelsior Band named for Pope's birth; father Alexander Pope
690.s: Pope born 1883; his father and friends formed the Excelsior Band that day. His father died aged 88 some years ago.
690.ch: Pope family and the Excelsior Band
690.q: 1883, November 23rd. So you're 76 years old. 76 years old, this year. Now, as I'm saying, the Excelsior Band was practically born, you understand, on the day that I was born. And I was getting together. My father and his friends. And they organized a band and named it the Excelsior Band, you see.

306.t: Edna Kelly's age and marriage to Chris Kelly
306.s: Allen opens Edna Kelly's interview. She was born about 1908, married the much older Chris young, and had a son at 16.
306.q: We're interviewing, see if we're getting a... Yeah, that's alright. We're interviewing Edna Kelly and today is December 15th, 1969. And let's see, it's 1907, the Feet Street, which you think. Alright, well, you're one of the few people, of course, that are alive now that would know anything, if…

309.t: Real birth dates and lost family records
309.s: Julius was born in 1907 though records say 1904; the family Bible was lost in a flood and he cannot recall his brothers' birthdays.
309.q: I'll tell you. My mother and my dad, they had, like my little group there, they had, uh... they had a Bible. in the head. My first day, they had Sylvester's, and they had Jones. Pardon me. Well, I always was, as far as the Bible, I was three years younger than, uh, Sylvester. And Sylvester was two…
